title: mut.cross_pollinate
mutation_directive: CROSS-POLLINATE: borrow the DOMINANT VISUAL SIGNATURE of a different favorited piece (from this list: 'n8q' Stanford Lucy figure, 'zs4' Lorenz attractor, '2n2' Aizawa attractor, 'w64' Lee Perry Smith head, 'kam' cypress↔art-deco morph, '8ug' audio-reactive shells, '7ea' differential growth, 'x09' L-system tree). Pick ONE that is most different from the current parent's direction. Now produce a child that COMBINES the parent's structural form with the chosen sibling's visual language (palette, motion law, or rendering technique — pick the most distinctive one). The result should feel like neither pure parent — something new emerges from the combination. The parent's RECOGNIZABLE FORM (statue, attractor shape, tree silhouette, etc.) should still be readable. State which sibling was chosen in a brief code comment at the top.
